component.name: LineCounter
component.summary: High-performance code line counter and file inspector

description.p: LineCounter is an ultra-fast cross-platform line and code counting application. It accurately counts all lines including pure empty lines, whitespace-only lines, and content lines with recursive directory scanning, instant inspection, and live text editing.
Initial release: ultra-fast Rust core, instant directory batch scanning, single file inspector, live paste, and soft line wrap.
